tex_content.html:
Corollary
↗ prop:unit-tangent-bundle-properties 1. ch12:12.25

If $(M,g)$ is compact and connected and its Ricci tensor is positive definite, then $\pi _1(M)$ is finite.

Proof

\sketch Compactness of the unit tangent bundle gives a uniform $c>0$ with $\operatorname {Rc}(v,v)\geq c$ for unit $v$. Apply Myers with $c=(n-1)/R^2$.

□
